audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer has Aurora's ability slots systematically wrong and invents one ability outright. It calls Across the Veil '(R)' when it is her W, calls Between Worlds '(E)' when it is her R, and names 'The Weight of Vengeance (W)' — an ability that does not exist in this kit. Eight fields carry the error: spikes[0], spikes[1], early, mid, late, wants.you[1], wants.foe[0], and the passive description in wants.you[0]. It also describes her damage as 'DoT-based' in three places.
audit.why: The kit gives Spirit Abjuration (P, spirits that follow her and HEAL her), Twofold Hex (Q, 900-range missile that curses and is recast to drag the curses back through you), Across the Veil (W, 22/21/20/19/18, leap into invisibility), The Weirding (E, 15/14/13/12/11, a slowing blast that hops her backward) and Between Worlds (R, 140/120/100 at 250 range, a shockwave with hard CC and a slow zone she can teleport across). Nothing in the kit is damage-over-time; the thing that makes her chip feel unkillable is the passive HEAL, which is a completely different problem with a completely different answer.
audit.corrected: Every slot label corrected, the invented ability removed, and 'DoT stacking' replaced with the real pattern — chip that Spirit Abjuration refunds. Added the missing interaction from the brief: Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades here. Also stated that Between Worlds is her hard CC at 140 seconds, which the page never mentioned at all.

audit.why: phases[N].side, content win[] and packet.levelChart all read Fizz on every row, and the kit supports it — her only genuine escape is a 22-second W, and Fizz's R reveals stealth, which is exactly the tool her escape pattern loses to. No row needed moving.
audit.corrected: Chart untouched. Whys edited only where they were misgendered or carried an unsourced magnitude, and every edited why still says Fizz wins that stage.

audit.why: No damage magnitudes exist in either kit. The real spike shape is level 3 pole, level 6 shark revealing her out of the veil, and first item beating a chip pattern she can no longer heal through.
audit.corrected: Both restated on the reveal and on her W cooldown.

audit.why: Across the Veil 22/21/20/19/18, The Weirding 15/14/13/12/11, Twofold Hex 9/8.5/8/7.5/7, Between Worlds 140/120/100.

notes:
CHART: no side edits. phases[N].side, content win[] and packet.levelChart all read Fizz on all seven rows and the kit supports that verdict, so nothing was moved. Every why I edited still says Fizz wins that stage.

SLOT LABELS WERE SYSTEMATICALLY WRONG. The content layer called Across the Veil '(R)' (it is W), called Between Worlds '(E)' (it is R), and invented 'The Weight of Vengeance (W)' outright. A player following it was tracking a 'blink' on the wrong cooldown entirely — the real W is 22 seconds and the real R is 140. Corrected across eight fields.

The suspectName the packet flagged, 'Use Across the Veil' in wants.foe[1], is a FALSE POSITIVE — that is her real W and the sentence uses it correctly. The genuine name defect was the one the checker missed, 'The Weight of Vengeance', because it is not a near-miss spelling of anything.

SECOND SUBSTANTIVE FIX: three fields called her damage 'DoT-based'. Nothing in her kit is damage-over-time. What actually makes her chip hard to out-trade is Spirit Abjuration HEALING her, which is the missing-interaction the brief flagged — so the answer is Grievous Wounds timing, not out-damaging a DoT. Written into tradeBad, breakdown.late, content.early and content.late.

Also added Between Worlds as her hard CC at 140/120/100. The page did not mention her ultimate having CC anywhere.
